text.p: These are the leading stories in Angola's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- At a recent meeting of the Southern African Development Community (SADC), the former UNITA rebel movement was told to abide by the spirit of the Lusaka protocol.
- Some 15,000 bodies of those who died in and around the city of Kuito during the civil war will be exhumed and reburied in an appropriate place in the coming months.
